$comment: Defaults for this install. Edit freely - changes apply on the next start. Anything you change in the setup page is saved separately (config.local.json) and wins over what is here; press Disconnect or delete that file to fall back to these. refreshSeconds (YouTube only): how often to check for new chat. Twitch and Kick push messages instantly and need no setting. YouTube is polled, and each check spends daily allowance, so lower = more responsive but shorter streams before it slows itself down.
